review_type: independent source review; no browser, native, build, or heavy test run
scope: guest AI allowance refusal in HTTP and NDJSON stream Chat paths
verdict_a_basis: The observed fourth-message HTTP 403 is mapped to the free-trial explanation only when the parsed flat response has error=guest_ai_allowance_used. Other HTTP 403 responses retain the access-denied message.
An open-stream error event with error_type or code guest_ai_allowance_used receives the same safe explanation and classified code. Other stream errors still use the server's user_message path.

The offscreen STREAM_CHUNK payload carries the classified code through the existing broadcast path. The Chat hook passes it to the presenter; done finalizes the assistant message. The presenter omits Retry for the exhausted allowance while ordinary errors retain Retry.

GuestBanner remains mounted at the top of Chat and its existing Sign up free button opens the configured frontend URL. The repair changes presentation only; the server allowance gate remains in force.
No exact installed Store or fresh candidate native run has yet proved that the fourth message renders this explanation or that the user can complete signup from it.
verdict_b_basis: The HTTP branch requires status 403 and an exact structured code; it never renders arbitrary response-body text or numeric allowance details.
The stream branch uses the server's structured error type and replaces only this recognized refusal with static user copy; existing unrelated stream errors retain their actionable messages.

The tests cover exact HTTP allowance, unrelated 403, midstream allowance, and presenter no-Retry behavior. Builder-reported targeted green and compile have valid resource decisions; this peer did not rerun them.
No quota calculation, paid-call seam, request identity, or backend gate was changed by the six-file product commit.
remaining_runtime_gate: Native exact-artifact guest proof must send through the allowance boundary, observe the real explanation and reachable signup action, while the server still refuses further guest AI use. A source verdict is not a product pass.
